description: Searches accommodation offers on noclegowo.pl (Poland) by location, dates, party (adults, children, pets), amenities, budget and free-text wishes. Returns offers with a summary line, guest rating, availability and the total stay price (when dates and party are given) and the offer link. Amenities are treated as preferences (offers that have them are ranked first); required_amenities are hard requirements; exclude_offer_ids leaves out offers already seen. Every request carries the full set of criteria. With dates, when fewer than 3 offers are available in the requested town, offers from nearby localities are included; they carry a `nearby` field with the distance and the requested place.

amenities.description: Amenities the user wishes for, in their words, e.g. ["śniadanie", "sauna", "parking"]. A preference rather than a filter: offers that have them are ranked first and the others follow with a note.

budget_scope.description: Whether the budget is per night (default) or for the whole stay.

children_ages.description: Ages of the children, when known.

exclude_offer_ids.description: Offer ids to leave out of the results (for example offers already seen), so that further results are new ones.

expectations.description: Other wishes in free text: type of place, style, atmosphere, distance to the beach or slopes, quiet area, etc. Personal data is not needed.

language.description: Language of the user's conversation ('pl' or 'en'). Determines the language of texts and the offer link locale.

limit.description: How many offers to return (default 6, max 10).

location.description: Where to stay: city, region, mountain range, lake, landmark or area in Poland, e.g. "Zakopane", "Mazury", "nad morzem", "near Morskie Oko".

pets.description: True when the guests travel with a pet (dog, cat, …).

required_amenities.description: Amenities that are hard requirements ("musi być", "koniecznie", "tylko z", "required"): offers without them are dropped.

name: search_accommodations

availability.description: available / unavailable for the requested dates; unknown = host confirms on inquiry; not_checked = no dates given or not verified.

nearby.description: Present on an alternative from a neighbouring locality, included because few offers were available in the requested place for these dates; the offer is not in the requested place.

distance_km.description: Distance from the centre of the requested location, km.

from.description: The requested location this offer is near.

price_from_pln.description: Indicative "from" nightly rate from the listing price list; per person or per property depending on the listing. Not the price for specific dates.

anyOf.description: Date-specific quote from the availability check, for the requested dates and party.

indicative.description: True when the total is plausible but not backed by the host's calendar, so it is an indicative price to be confirmed with the host.

total.description: Total for the whole stay and the whole party, PLN.

stay_price_withheld.description: Set when the offer is available but the booking system quoted a total that failed plausibility checks; total_price_pln and stay_price are then null and the price for the dates is to be confirmed with the host.

total_price_pln.description: Same as stay_price.total; null without a quote.

url.description: Offer page on noclegowo.pl (the URL carries attribution parameters).

questions.description: When status=needs_more_info: the information missing for a search.

title: Search accommodation
